summary: Configured a persistent web service on node1 at 127.0.0.1:8081. It remains reachable through loopback and unreachable through the external address 10.100.46.10 after a verified node reboot.
actions_performed: Created the web document root and systemd service.
Enabled and started loopback-web.service with an explicit 127.0.0.1 bind.
Verified the page through loopback and connection rejection through the external interface.
Safely rebooted node1 and verified service, content, and network isolation recovered.

evidence.requirement: Web service is reachable through loopback but not external interfaces
evidence.summary: ss shows only 127.0.0.1:8081 listening; loopback HTTP returns the expected page, while 10.100.46.10:8081 rejects the connection before and after restart.
systemd reports loopback-web.service enabled and active initially and after reboot.

Healthy baseline used boot ID b4e86aa0-4c66-496b-b950-2972794ccf9d; the safe reboot was acknowledged; the new boot ID is c7a1bd2b-e5ad-4cca-8fcc-12885866339d; service health, identical content checksum, loopback access, and external-interface isolation were all recovered.
